The exact-source replay test compiles/runs the real helper with aligned classes (wide allowed), a 192-column split (wide refused), and non-block-E4M3 formats (legacy selection preserved). The full production source prefix through rad0048 composed cleanly at upstream SHA 3deabdaeca17b58bad90d332f4b204cf7bb8a10e and ABI44. On that exact composition, the card-free ABI44 KV layout/fingerprint fixture passed; a narrow libr3 ABI44 plugin built and a no-GPU row probe found both helper rows with live launches; native libr4d row and MoE objects compiled for gfx1201; and the ABI44 moe-remote worker plus mailbox plugin built. Package lifecycle remains untested pending qualifying activation/correctness evidence and review under PATCH_SYSTEM; numerical qualification remains RUM09.
